name: Flashforge Adventurer 5M / 5M Pro stock toolhead (quick-swap hotend, magnetic front cover with part-fan duct)
provenance: Flashforge Adventurer 5M / 5M Pro stock toolhead (quick-swap hotend, magnetic front cover with part-fan duct) Confidence: medium. Sources: https://www.printables.com/model/1756742 (head_nozzle_ad5m.stp: CAD of the stock AD5M quick-swap hotend with its 3010 fan; used for the nozzle, sock and hotend); https://www.printables.com/model/914048 (AD5M_FAN_V3.stl: stock-height remodel of JakeP3D's stock-replacement front cover/duct, modelled in assembly orientation; used for the duct footprint); https://www.printables.com/model/782158 (JakeP3D stock-replacement duct: same 104 mm overall height as 914048); https://www.printables.com/model/1256784 (Sergey Sergeev duct, standard and '4mmToBed' variants sharing one datum: the 4 mm variant is 103.5 mm tall, so the 104 mm stock-height duct is about 3.5 mm above the tip); https://www.printables.com/model/1805877 (bruce duct traced from the original part: same top datum, 102.6 mm tall); https://www.printables.com/model/1405210 (makko AD5M-ToolHead.step: drop-in replacement for the stock frame; supplies the hotend bayonet seat, the frame depth and the rear plate); resources/profiles/Flashforge/flashforge_adventurer_5m_series_hotend.stl (GUI preview: 6 mm stub 0..3.5 mm, consistent with the CAD's exposed nozzle); resources/profiles/Flashforge/machine/fdm_adventurer5m_common.json (extruder_clearance_height_to_rod = 27, extruder_clearance_radius = 76). Tip frame; +Y is the back of the printer. NOZZLE (measured): taken from the stock-hotend CAD in Printables 1756742 (head_nozzle_ad5m.stp, the hotend part). The tip cone radius is about 1.0 at z=0 and grows about 1 mm per mm (45 deg) to a 6.3 mm body. The sock/housing nose starts at z 3.3-3.5 (r 5.5 at z 4), and the housing is about 20x26 mm up to z 28. This matches the repo GUI stub (6 mm diameter, 0..3.5). exposed_nozzle_length is set to 3.3. DUCT HEIGHT (derived): the stock-replacement covers (JakeP3D 782158 and its remodel 914048 V3) are 104.0 mm from top edge to arm bottom. Sergey's '4mmToBed' variant, which shares its top datum with his standard variant and with bruce's traced-original duct, is 103.5 mm, which puts a 104 mm stock duct about 3.5 mm above the tip. The jhead custom cap (1756742) sits 2.9 mm above the tip. The duct bottom is set at 3.0, about 0.3-0.5 below the inference, as margin. DUCT XY (derived): taken from 914048 V3 sections, centred in X on the 60 mm cover. Y is the union of two placements. (A) The U arms are centred on the nozzle: nozzle 13.5 mm behind the cover's rear face. (B) The cover's rear face sits on the front of the makko stock-replica frame: the hotend bayonet seat is 18.3 mm behind the frame front, so the nozzle is 18.3 mm behind the cover's rear face. The union gives front -36.5 and arm tips +13.6. BODY: the makko 1405210 frame is a drop-in for the stock frame. Its bottom plate underside (z~28) was mated to the top of the hotend housing, the hotend axis to the bayonet circle, and the rear plate legs reach down to z 19.0 at y +16.7..+24. The X carriage behind the rear plate (to y +40) is estimated. GANTRY: z from Flashforge's own extruder_clearance_height_to_rod = 27 for the AD5M, minus 0.3. Its y range 22..60 is estimated (X rods/rail and carriage behind the toolhead rear plate). X sign: the head is symmetric to within 1 mm, so footprints are mirrored about x=0. Footprints include about 0.3 mm margin. Footnote: the duct height comes from cross-remix inference rather than a direct measurement of the stock part, about +/-0.7 mm; the nozzle Y offset within the duct (13.5 vs 18.3) is covered by the union. PARTS: one box per component in the tip frame, without the 0.3 mm margin (the engine adds it). The front cover is an inverted U. Its two legs, with the U-arm outlets, reach down to z 3.0, and there is no cover material within |x|<10 below z 25, where the arch begins. The arm and leg boxes therefore stay separate either side of the nozzle gap. Duct z 3.0 = best inference 3.5 minus 0.5 uncertainty. Arm and leg Y extents are the union of the two placements (rear face at -12.5 or -18.3), and outer X steps follow the chamfer. The hotend fan and carriage are estimated and extended by their uncertainty: the fan by mirror ambiguity in X, the carriage by ±2 mm laterally and 3 mm downward. The part-cooling blower sits inside the cover bridge box. Nozzle: land radius 1.00 mm, 46.5-degree cone to Z=1.00, then the nozzle parts as recorded. Gantry: X beam underside 26.70 mm above the tip, Y 22.0..60.0, every X. Converted by scripts/nonplanar_heads/open_heads.py from research/head-envelopes/flashforge-ad5m.json (2026-10-13). Nozzle-tip frame +X right, +Y rear, +Z up, mm. Body axial/lateral margins 0.3 mm. Not calibrated.
